
cdrom/cd-ack-window
A sector waiting behind a command's INT3: how late may the acknowledge come for the drive to announce it in the
same pass, and does a ReadN written just after the acknowledge get in first? Needs a data disc.
Cycles at the system clock (1 ms = 33,869). No assertions - compare against your emulator.

drive region: for U/C - unlocking (a burned disc needs it; a pressed one ignores it)
2x, mode A0h: INT1 period 226118 cycles
